title: Aunt Beru
subtitle: Independent
description: Beru Whitesun was content to marry her beau, Owen Lars, and remain on Tatooine and lead the difficult life of a moisture farmer on a desert world. But when Obi-Wan Kenobi delivered young Luke Skywalker to her and her husband to raise, she gained a new mission and would stop at nothing to protect her nephew -even if that meant fighting off the likes of an Inquisitor.
